nodes.name: NiCoS NAs Hydrothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Nickel nitrate hexahydrate, cobalt nitrate hexahydrate, ammonium fluoride, urea, and sodium thiosulfate as sulfur source were used in hydrothermal reaction on nickel foam. Through one-step heating reaction, uniform nanorod arrays vertically grew at the open porous skeleton structure of nickel foam.

unit_operations.name: Hydrothermal growth
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: sodium thiosulfate was used as a sulfur source in hydrothermal reactions. Through the one-step heating reaction

nodes.source_text: Without involving aggressive chemicals such as sulfur, sodium sulfide, thiourea, and thioacetamide, sodium thiosulfate was used as a sulfur source in hydrothermal reactions. Through the one-step heating reaction, the uniform nanorod arrays vertically grew

nodes.name: NiFe LDHs Hydrothermal Deposition
nodes.procedure: Nickel nitrate hexahydrate and iron nitrate nonahydrate were used to decorate NiFe LDHs on NiCoS nanorod arrays via hydrothermal method to form NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs/NF hierarchical structure electrode.

unit_operations.name: Hydrothermal decoration
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: NiFe LDHs were decorated on the nanorod arrays with a hydrothermal method

nodes.source_text: Subsequently, NiFe LDHs were decorated on the nanorod arrays with a hydrothermal method to form the NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs/NF

nodes.name: Annealing Transformation
nodes.procedure: NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs/NF was annealed at 200°C under Ar atmosphere for 2 h. The characteristic peaks of NiFe LDHs disappear, transforming into mixed-phase Ni(OH)₂ and Fe₂O₃, referred to as (Ni,Fe)O(OH)@NiCoS NAs. This triggers production of localized oxygen vacancies.

unit_operations.name: Annealing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs/NF was annealed at 200°C under Ar conditions for 2 h

nodes.source_text: NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs/NF electrodes were implemented after 2 h of annealing under Ar conditions at 200°C... the mixed-phase metal (oxy)hydroxide/metal oxide catalyst was referred to as (Ni,Fe)O(OH)

nodes.description: HER performance in alkaline simulated seawater
nodes.source_text: NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs showed a minimal potential for HER at large-current conditions... low Tafel slope of 78.8 mV dec⁻¹ for HER

nodes.description: Overall water splitting stability in symmetric configuration
nodes.source_text: NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs/NF||NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs/NF for overall water splitting in the 1.0 M KOH + 0.5 M NaCl solution of 50 °C... under a constant current density of 200 mA cm⁻² maintained stable overall water splitting over 100 h in the simulated seawater electrolyte with a low potential of ∼1.72 V

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images show hierarchical nanorod arrays of NiCoS NAs/NF, disordered film-like NiFe LDHs on bare NF, and ordered NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images of the (a) NiCoS NAs, (b) NiFe LDHs grown directly on the bare nickel foam, and (c) NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM verifies uniform loading of Ni-Fe active phase coating layer on NiCoS geometric carrier layer of (Ni,Fe)O(OH)@NiCoS NAs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images in Fig. 2(d) further verified a uniform loading of the Ni-Fe active phase coating layer on the NiCoS geometric carrier layer...

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM displays strongly coupled heterointerface between NiCoS NAs and (Ni,Fe)O(OH) with lattice planes d=0.286 nm (311) NiCo2S4 and d=0.295 nm (220) Fe2O3.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HRTEM image in Fig. 2(d) displays a strongly coupled heterointerface and well-defined heterogeneous interfaces presented between NiCoS NAs and (Ni,Fe)O(OH).

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS mapping and line scan show homogeneous distribution of Ni, Co, Fe, O, and S elements in core-shell structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) mapping analysis (Fig. 2b) and EDS line scan (Fig. 2c) results further displayed a homogeneous distribution of Ni, Co, Fe, O and S elements...

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD of NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs/NF after 200°C annealing shows peaks indexed to Ni(OH)2 (JCPDS: 04-021-6327) and Fe2O3 (JCPDS: 04-015-9904); after 300°C annealing shows additional NiFe2O4 (220), (311), (511) peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: After 2 h of annealing under Ar conditions at 200°C, the characteristic peaks of NiFe LDHs... are well indexed to Ni(OH)2... and Fe2O3... After 300°C annealing, the additional diffraction peaks... are attributed to... NiFe2O4.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS O 1s of (Ni,Fe)O(OH)@NiCoS NAs shows lattice oxygen at 530.8 eV, defect oxygen at 532.0 eV (33.6% vs 8.2% in precursor); Fe 2p3/2 shifts from 711.0 eV to 713.4 eV indicating electron transfer to oxygen vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: By comparing the O 1s XPS spectra before and after the thermal treatment (Fig. 1h), the lattice oxygen... and defect oxygen peaks of NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs located at 531.4 and 532.6 eV shifted toward low binding energy at 530.8 and 532.0 eV...

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman shows Ni-S peaks at 150-380 cm^-1, NiFe LDHs peaks at 459 and 532 cm^-1 shifting to 521 cm^-1 after annealing indicating structural disorder; Fe(III)-OH at 577 cm^-1 and Fe(III)-O at 690 cm^-1.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Surface-sensitive Raman spectrum was conducted to reveal the evolution of electrode composition... the Ni(II)-O stretching band at 532 cm^-1 in NiFe LDHs shifted to a lower frequency at 521 cm^-1.

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando EC-Raman shows transformation from α-Ni(OH)2 to γ-NiOOH with Ni(III)-O peaks at 480 cm^-1 (Eg) and 560 cm^-1 (A1g); Fe(III)-OH at 577 cm^-1 dominates.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The dynamic electrochemical reconstruction processes of (Ni,Fe)O(OH)@NiCoS NAs under working conditions were recorded via operando Electrochemistry-Raman (EC-Raman) techniques...

nodes.characterization_summary: TOF-SIMS shows increased sulfate species SOx^2-/1- after activation forming three-dimensional anion gradient layers; similar distribution with sulfur-containing species.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (TOF-SIMS) mapping on (Ni,Fe)O(OH)@NiCoS NAs/NF after oxygen revolution... exhibited a more distinct signal intensity of sulfate species...

nodes.characterization_summary: Non-faradaic CV gives Cdl = 60.44 mF cm^-2 for (Ni,Fe)O(OH)@NiCoS NAs/NF and 56.50 mF cm^-2 for NiCoS NAs/NF indicating high ECSA from hierarchical nanostructure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The (Ni,Fe)O(OH)@NiCoS NAs/NF (60.44 mF cm^-2) and NiCoS NAs/NF (56.50 mF cm^-2) have a larger Cdl than the (Ni,Fe)O(OH)/NF (25.69 mF cm^-2)...

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows smallest charge transfer resistance and highest electron lifetime for (Ni,Fe)O(OH)@NiCoS NAs indicating fastest charge transfer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) Nyquist plots revealed the smallest charge transfer resistance of (Ni,Fe)O(OH)@NiCoS NAs (Fig. 3d).

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando DEMS with 18O-labeling shows strong 36O2 (m/z=36) and 34O2 (m/z=34) signals indicating lattice-oxygen-participated mechanism.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The operando differential electrochemical mass spectrometry (DEMS) measurements with isotope labeling... indicating the involvement of the oxygen located at catalyst lattice...

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando EC-FTIR shows peaks at 1133 cm^-1 (metal-O-O) and 3590 cm^-1 (*OH) increasing at OER potential confirming LOM mechanism intermediates.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in the operando EC-FTIR spectra in Fig. 4(d), distinctive absorption peaks found at 1133 and 3590 cm^-1 were dramatically increased...

nodes.characterization_summary: XRF shows decreased Ni/Fe ratio after 200°C annealing indicating crystal transformation from LDHs to LDOs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Besides, as shown in the XRF quantification (Table S1), the ratio of Ni and Fe was decreased after 200°C annealing...

nodes.characterization_summary: TGA-DSC shows three weight loss regions for NiFe LDHs@NiCoS NAs: physisorbed water loss, chemisorbed water/hydroxyl removal at 170-280°C forming (Ni,Fe)O(OH), and LDO formation above 290°C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To optimize the annealing temperature, the thermal gravimetric analyzer (TGA) and differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) were conducted... three weightlessness regions were presented.
